mentions.name: Browser-based MUD
mentions.description: A browser-based MUD (multi-user dungeon) whose game engine runs in a web worker and communicates with the UI via message passing. Area data files are stored remotely and cached with a service worker so the MUD can run offline, and multiplayer is handled by the MUD opening an outbound connection (likely websocket) to a connection collector host that routes other players' IO, with IndexedDB as the likely database.
mentions.audience: MUD players, whether playing solo offline or connecting remotely for multiplayer
mentions.source_excerpt:
The new one is browser based.

The mud engine runs in a web worker and takes advantage of some of the modern web tricks to do stuff. For instance, data files (think: area files that don't change often) can be stored remotely and then cached with a service worker. This allows the MUD to run offline.
